brief.prompt:
INITIAL PROMPT
Use case: illustration-story / editorial basketball thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ, PNG, landscape 16:9, ideally 1600x900 or 1536x864, width at least 1000 pixels. This is a new hand-drawn illustration, not a photo.

ART DIRECTION: approved black-and-lime ink/brush style. Near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B broad expressive diagonal brush streaks, warm ivory bold Japanese display type, a little orange only on the basketball. Strong handmade ink strokes and crosshatching, clean highly legible typography, few elements, premium sports editorial design. Match the black/lime sports illustration art direction already viewed, but never carry over its player, names, score, date or shooting composition.

MAIN SUBJECT: exactly one REAL professional player, Jeremy Combs (ジェレミー・コームズ), currently on Niigata Albirex BB roster, selected randomly solely as an illustrative subject. His official roster portrait has been visually checked at https://www.albirex.com/team/players/detail/id=24944?PlayerID=42691 and https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026102015/files/user/roster/695/2026-27/42691_01.jpg .
Appearance observed in that official portrait: adult Black man, tall athletic muscular build, medium-dark brown skin, oval slightly long face, high forehead, medium length black locs loosely hanging around ears down to upper neck with several distinct locks over his forehead; thick full dense black beard extended below the chin, connected moustache; relatively straight dark eyebrows, calm almond-shaped dark eyes, broad nose and full lips. Maintain these recognizable facial features; do not give him a short afro, a clean shaven face, a different athlete's likeness, or a fictional generic basketball face. Render his face clearly with warm ivory highlights and ink shadows, not blacked out. Keep the real athlete's likeness in a clearly drawn illustration.
Pose: dynamic three-quarter view, crouching and stepping forward strongly, both hands firmly and naturally holding the orange basketball at chest-to-waist height in preparation for a powerful drive. Shoulders twisted slightly, face visible looking diagonally left/up toward the play. Show from head through knees, keep the complete head, both elbows, both hands and whole basketball inside frame; five natural fingers where visible, no extra arms. Cropping below the thighs/knees is acceptable. Plain unbranded charcoal and ivory sleeveless basketball uniform, no lettering, no jersey numbers, no team logos, no sponsor marks. Subtle drawn arm tattoo shapes may be visible, no readable tattoo words.
This is ONLY a generic imagined basketball action illustration of a real athlete; NOT a reconstruction of any actual game, point, winning shot, appearance or achievement. No hoop, opponent, crowd, scoreboard, trophies or medals.

LAYOUT: subject occupies right 45 percent, with strong upward-left diagonal energy and a few controlled lime brush marks behind him. Left 55 percent is spacious editorial type, all text clear and separated from the subject. Keep all text within 5 percent safe margins. Header small at top left. Main headline huge, warm ivory, strong Japanese Gothic. Date lime. The EFF pending state is clear, high contrast, and separate from game results. Footer disclaimers comfortably readable and never cropped. Do not imitate an official league graphic.

TEXT: Render ONLY the following exact strings, with no other text, no player's name, no team names, no scores or player statistics:
Top left small: 「バスケまとめ」
Date: 「2026.11.04」
Main headline very large: 「試合結果」
Secondary headline: 「当日のEFFは」
Next line emphasized lime: 「確定待ち」
Supporting qualifier below: 「19:54時点・一部試合は未確定」
Footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

EDITORIAL FACT BOUNDARY: The fixed article says game statuses are as of 2026-11-04 19:54 JST. Some matches are not yet officially finalized. The day's EFF ranking will be posted after all games' official records are finalized; no EFF player names or ranks are available. Do not imply this randomly selected athlete appeared, scored, won, or led EFF that day. The illustration's labels must be exactly イラスト（AI生成） and イメージ, not 成績をもとにしたイメージ.
Avoid photorealism, photo collage, official photographic pixels, generic fictional player, league/team/sponsor logos, badges, garbled Japanese, excessive small print, clipped ball or fingers, duplicated limbs, and visual clutter.

ONE CORRECTION PROMPT
Edit the first input image, a finished Japanese black/lime basketball thumbnail. This is the ONE final correction. Preserve the entire exact text, colors, typographic hierarchy, and editorial meaning. Fix ONLY the athlete's framing and refine his likeness against the second input official portrait.
1. The top of his locs is currently touching/clipped by the upper edge. Scale the athlete with ball uniformly about 8 percent smaller and position so every hair tip has at least 45 pixels of clear background above it. Keep both hands, both elbows and the complete ball comfortably within the canvas. Natural crop of legs at the lower edge is fine. Do not add a panel or change the landscape 1672x941 approximately 16:9 format.

Keep the drawn face identifiable, clear, and not in heavy shadow. Do not paste any photographic pixels. Do not copy official uniform logos or text.
